en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the equestrian statue of Matthias Corvinus with four companions on a large pedestal in a city square. Printed title at top reads "CLUJ – Statuia lui Matei Corvin." The reverse has Romanian text and address lines, a blue airmail stamp of 40 bani with an airplane, postal cancellations reading București, and the header "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ."
